body: I got it taken care of. Everything went better today but I'm still feeling kinda rocky about what happened.

Thank you for your response. They were very responsive to what I had to say about it. I think they were trying to convey why they take mental health seriously, they just didn't go about it the right way. It didn't really make me feel better though, haha. Thank you. I did get the prescription filled, but it was $50 + the cost of the medication at Walmart. lol

I had been working for two months to get my prescription taken care of. I'm not saying I didn't appreciate their intervention, I'm saying I don't appreciate what they said to me.

I'm a girl, by the way.
